summary: Turn a murder-mystery or indie-game script into a labeled multi-character voice pack. This AI game voice pack and character dialogue studio casts one consistent voice per role, records every line in script order, and delivers numbered clips with character IDs ready for an engine or tabletop production. Use it for game voice acting, indie game dialogue, murder mystery voiceover, multi character TTS, NPC voice acting, interactive story audio, tabletop voice pack work, and scripted game audio.
